title: Correct flight time
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the time in the air must be 0.4 s.

title: Correct final speed
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the speed upon impact must be 5 m/s.

title: Correct impact angle
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the direction must be an angle of 53° relative to the horizontal.

title: Correct gravitational power
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the power of gravity must be 40 W.

title: Horizontal motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply uniform motion to relate horizontal distance, initial velocity, and flight time.

title: Vertical motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply kinematics for free-fall to find the vertical velocity component.

title: Vector composition of velocity
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the Pythagorean theorem to find the magnitude of the final velocity from its components.

title: Trigonometry for direction
description: Important: The solution must correctly use a trigonometric function (e.g., tangent) to find the impact angle.

title: Power formula application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the formula for instantaneous power (P = F * v * cosθ) for gravity, recognizing the force is vertical.

title: Incorrect time calculation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly calculates flight time (e.g., uses t = x/v0 but with wrong arithmetic, yielding 0.3 s).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student makes a sign error in vector components or omits/incorrectly uses units in final answers.
